note: Mahaska County Conservation Board campground on the Des Moines River SW of Beacon, in east and west sides, with a concrete boat ramp and two cabins next door. The east side's road runs along the sandy riverbank with the pads on its inland side. --Claude
summary: Booking reservable -> NO RESERVATIONS, FCFS always (county FAQ). Water hookup -> no (hydrants only). $20, 44 sites, 30/50-amp, 14 nights confirmed; season added. Riverfront -> riverview lead.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD: stored riverfront rests on 'the eastern loop's outer pads sit on the open sandy riverbank', which imagery doesn't bear out. Esri z19 at 41.2352,-92.7345: the east side's own loop road runs along the bank, about 20-30 m back from the river's sandy edge, and every pad or parked RV visible is on its inland side, in the loop's interior or the south row. The scalloped sand patches on the river side of the road show no pads, tracks or rigs. AWH's 2026-11-01 ruling: a campground's own loop road blocks on-water. The river is 150 m+ wide, open, and plainly visible across the road, so riverview. County says only 'adjacent to the Des Moines River'. West side is further back behind trees and brush. If those sand patches are in fact used as sites, a camper photo would change this, but I found none; unsure means down.

Website, phone 641-673-9327 and pin all confirmed: pin at the picnic shelter between the two sides. Mycountyparks page carries only the cabins and shelter for booking, which explains the stored 'reservable' value.
Dump station: no page mentions one; left unset.
